title: Location & Operations and User Inventory tiles: evenly spread
items: The small figures under each tile are chips spread evenly across the tile (like Justify in Word): label on the left, number on the right.

title: Smaller summary tiles
items: Number and country split on one line — Dashboard, Asset Inventory and User Inventory tiles take about half the height.

title: "New app function update" box on the Dashboard
items: See what was deployed lately, newest first.

title: Asset & User Inventory: new summary tiles
items: Same style as the Dashboard: big number + split by country.
Click a tile or a country chip to filter the list (Needs Info opens Needs Attention for that country).

title: Custody Agreement prints on one A4 page
items: No more second page when printing.

title: User Inventory fits the screen
items: Email shows under the name, Devices column removed — all columns visible without scrolling sideways.

title: Lists show the latest changes first
items: Asset Inventory and User Inventory are sorted by last updated, with a Last updated column and New / Edited tags.

title: Devices page (Intune & Entra) — IT admin
items: Microsoft device list linked to assets and users.
Bulk import is paused for now; the first import was undone.

title: Users can manage one or more countries
items: Viewer / Editor / Admin can be global (all countries) or limited to the countries they manage.

title: Custody Agreement (HQ form)
items: New 🖨️ button in asset details prints the HQ custody form, incl. Asset No (S/4).

title: Needs Attention: fix missing info on the spot
items: Split by country, edit directly in the list — no need to open each asset.
Missing AD Name / PC No only checked for laptops and desktops.

title: Dashboard redesign
items: Totals split by country and status, Assets by Country / Type, Vietnam Office & Factory.
Top Models and Alerts side by side; Alerts is a pop-up button on the inventory pages.

title: Asset Inventory improvements
items: Years in Use column (from purchase date), Asset Type filter, Office / Factory filter.
Laptops, desktops and phones listed first; "Code" renamed to "Asset code".
